name: cascade-agent-architect
description: Designs source-grounded AI agent and agentic-system architectures, roles, skills, workflows, prompts, tools, memory, safety, and architecture-specific evaluation packs without owning generic evaluation or simulation runtimes.

interface.shortDescription: Design and improve complete AI agent systems.
interface.longDescription: Extract and cluster capabilities, select the smallest sufficient topology, and generate reviewable agent, role, skill, workflow, prompt, context, memory, tool, permission, observability, and architecture-evaluation contracts while delegating prompt authoring to Cascade Prompt, generic evaluation to Cascade Evals, and bounded execution to Cascade Simulations.
defaultPrompt: Design a complete AI agent architecture for this request.
Turn these capabilities into bounded roles, skills, workflows, and prompts.
Evaluate and improve this agent system through Cascade Evals.
